ud6.4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud6.4:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nānātitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paribbājakā Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisanti nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā nānādiṭṭhinissayanissitā.
ud6.4:2.2: sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:3.1: santi pan' eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
ud6.4:3.2: asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:4.2: antavā loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:5.1: santi pan' eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
ud6.4:5.2: anantavā loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:6.2: taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:7.1: santi pan' eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
ud6.4:7.2: aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:8.2: hoti tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:9.1: santi pan' eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
ud6.4:9.2: na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:10.2: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:11.2: n' eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.
ud6.4:12.1: te bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti:
ud6.4:13.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃsu,
ud6.4:13.2: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
ud6.4:13.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud6.4:14.1: idha bhante sambahulā nānātitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paribbājakā Sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti nānādiṭṭhikā . . .
ud6.4:16.2: atthaṃ na jānanti, anatthaṃ na jānanti, dhammaṃ na jānanti, adhammaṃ na jānanti.
ud6.4:16.3: te atthaṃ ajānantā anatthaṃ ajānantā dhammaṃ ajānantā adhammaṃ ajānantā bhaṇḍanajātā . . . pe . . .
ud6.4:17.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave imissāy' eva Sāvatthiyaṃ aññataro rājā ahosi.
ud6.4:17.2: atha kho bhikkhave so rājā aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.4:17.3: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa yāvatikā Sāvatthiyaṃ jaccandhā, te sabbe ekajjhaṃ sannipātehī 'ti.
ud6.4:17.4: evaṃ devā 'ti kho bhikkhave so puriso tassa rañño paṭissutvā yāvatikā Sāvatthiyaṃ jaccandhā , te sabbe gahetvā yena so rājā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ rājānaṃ etad avoca:
ud6.4:17.5: sannipātitā kho te deva yāvatikā Sāvatthiyaṃ jaccandhā 'ti.
ud6.4:17.6: tena hi bhaṇe jaccandhānaṃ hatthiṃ dassehī 'ti.
ud6.4:17.7: evaṃ devā 'ti kho bhikkhave so puriso tassa rañño paṭissutvā jaccandhānaṃ hatthiṃ dassesi: ediso jaccandhā hatthī 'ti.
ud6.4:19.1: atha kho bhikkhave so puriso jaccandhānaṃ hatthiṃ dassetvā yena so rājā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ rājānaṃ etad avoca:
ud6.4:19.2: diṭṭho kho tehi deva jaccandehi hatthī,
ud6.4:20.1: atha kho bhikkhave so rājā yena te jaccandhā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te jaccandhe etad avoca:
ud6.4:21.1: yehi bhikkhave jaccandhehi hatthissa sīsaṃ diṭṭhaṃ ahosi, te evam āhaṃsu:
ud6.4:21.2: ediso deva hatthī, seyyathā pi kumbho 'ti.
ud6.4:22.1: yehi bhikkhave jaccandhehi hatthissa kaṇṇo diṭṭho ahosi, te evam āhaṃsu:
ud6.4:22.2: ediso deva hatthī, seyyathā pi suppo 'ti.
ud6.4:23.1: yehi bhikkhave jaccandhehi hatthissa danto diṭṭho ahosi, te evam āhaṃsu:
ud6.4:28.1: yehi . . . naṅguṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ ahosi, te evam āhaṃsu:
ud6.4:30.1: te ediso hatthī, n' ediso hatthī,
ud6.4:30.2: n' ediso hatthī, ediso hatthī 'ti aññamaññaṃ muṭṭhīhi saṃsubhiṃsu .
ud6.4:30.3: tena ca pana bhikkhave so rājā attamano ahosi,
ud6.4:31.1: evam eva kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā andhā acakkhukā . . .
ud6.4:32.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
